text:
Joplin Jailbirds Veteran Appreciation Night
Date: 25 July 2026
Gates open at 6 PM game starts at 7 pm
Location: Joe Becker Stadium Joplin MO
Pregame tickets are $9 by going to the website listed. $3 of each ticket goes to Heartland Canines for Veterans!
You can purchase tickets the night of the game for $10 at the gate, so save a dollar and help us out by getting your tickets here!
Questions? Contact Jimmy Burgess, director@heartlandk9s.org
We are actively looking for sponsors for this event.
The Joplin Jailbirds are a Non-Profit MINK League Team (Like the Joplin Outlaws used to be). We are excited to partner with them to bring good wholesome baseball back to Joplin. Help them help us by attending! There will be more info to follow as we get closer to game night!
Purchase Game tickets here
